summary: 11 countries. Diplomacy leads today: Rubio opens a Latin America tour, Tokyo and Seoul manoeuvre around the Xi visit later this month, and Trump's envoys move between Moscow and Kyiv. Around that, outlets carry the Canada tariff fight, pressure on the Fed, a bond market warning, a court ruling on deportation over speech, new limits on international student internships, the Iran tanker war, an Iceland map protest, and lighter items from the US Open to the box office.
